subject: Behavioral Economics
title: Visual Salience and Attention
description: One-minute skill: Visual Salience and Attention.

hook.text: A bright orange Buy Now button converts 32% more than a grey one. The product is the same.

buildup.text: Visual salience means making one element stand out. The brain's attention is drawn to contrast, color, and size.

discovery.text: Visual Salience and Attention reveals the behavioral mechanism driving the outcome.

twist.text: Salience can also hide. Terms and conditions are grey, small, and at the bottom. Low salience is a design decision too.

climax.text: On any purchase page, look for what is hidden as carefully as what is highlighted.

punchline.text: What they make hard to see is what they hope you miss.

quiz.question: Why are terms of service displayed in small grey text?
options: To save space on the webpage
Low visual salience reduces the chance customers will read them
Legal requirements mandate that font size
